site.title: Echelon | Interschool tech fest at Bangalore International School
site.description: Echelon is an interschool tech fest for students in Grades 8–12, run by Bangalore International School in collaboration with Vidyashilp University. Seven events to code, build, pitch and race.

event.name: Echelon
event.tagline: Like migrating birds, we rise in formation.
event.summary: The interschool tech fest for Grades 8–12. Seven events to code, build, pitch and race, run in collaboration with Vidyashilp University.
event._dateHelp: Set date to an ISO date with the India offset, for example 2027-01-16T08:30:00+05:30. Leave it empty to show 'Date to be announced'.

about.statement: Code it. Build it. Pitch it. Race it.
about.heading: Built for students who like making things work
paragraphs: Echelon is an interschool tech fest run by Bangalore International School in collaboration with Vidyashilp University.
Students in Grades 8–12 form teams, represent their school and compete in hands-on events, from writing code to escape a glass room to racing a drone through an obstacle course.

cards.title: Seven ways to compete
cards.text: Coding, game design, data puzzles, pitching, building with e-waste and drone racing.

cards.title: Teams from your school
cards.text: Team up with classmates and go up against students from other schools.

cards.title: One morning on campus
cards.text: Everything happens at Bangalore International School, from 8:30 am to 1:30 pm.

steps.title: Pick your events
steps.text: Seven events, from coding your way out of an escape room to racing a drone. Each card lists the grades, team size and what you need to know.

steps.title: Form a team
steps.text: Team up with classmates. Teams are two to four students, depending on the event.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Sign your team up on the official registration form.

steps.title: Compete
steps.text: Arrive at Bangalore International School by 8:30 am and compete against other schools.

events.heading: Seven events. Pick yours.
events.intro: Every event has its own team size and grade range, so check the details before you sign up.

items.name: Escape Room
items.summary: Write the program code to get the clue and escape the glass room.
about: Your team is locked in a glass room.
Write the program code, in Java or Python, to get the clue.
Find the key using the clue in the code, then use it to escape.

items.name: Game Design
items.summary: Create a game that promotes sustainability.
items.priorKnowledge: A game development tool such as Greenfoot or p5.js
items.resources: Bring your own laptop with the software installed
about: Create a game that promotes sustainability.
Use any game development software you like, such as Greenfoot or p5.js.
rules: Your laptop must not contain any part of the game code before the event starts.

items.name: Treasure Hunt
items.summary: Data analysis and logic puzzles using Excel.
items.priorKnowledge: Excel, binary arithmetic and number conversions
about: Plot the chart to find the path.
Reach the midpoint and solve the puzzle to get the clue.
Forge your map and mark your treasure.

items.name: Shark Tank
items.summary: Pitch an idea built around the theme 'Sawubona', meaning 'I see you'.
about: A recreation of the TV show Shark Tank, with ideas built around the theme 'Sawubona' (I see you).
Your idea can be an app, a project plan or a business plan.
Present it using any presentation tool.
rules: Submit your presentation before the deadline set by the organisers.

items.name: E-Waste Reimagined
items.summary: Create a reusable product out of e-waste.
items.duration: 2 hours to build, 5 minutes to present
about: Create a reusable product using e-waste.
Build it on campus during the event, then present it in five minutes.
rules: The product must be built at the event, on campus.

items.name: Drone Race
items.summary: Fly your drone through a course of obstacles against the clock.
about: Each team brings a drone and navigates it through a series of fun, challenging obstacles.
rules: Drones must fit within 25 cm × 25 cm × 5 cm.

items.name: Web Designing
items.summary: Code a website using HTML and JavaScript around the theme 'Sawubona'.
about: Each team codes a website using HTML and JavaScript around the theme 'Sawubona' (I see you).

schedule.heading: One morning on campus
schedule.intro: The clock runs from doors open to wrap-up as you scroll.

before.title: Register your teams
before.text: Sign up on the official registration form.

before.title: Shark Tank decks
before.text: Shark Tank teams submit their presentation before the deadline.

day.title: Doors open
day.text: Teams arrive and check in at Bangalore International School.

day.title: Events under way
day.text: Events run through the morning. They last from 25 minutes (Escape Room) to two and a half hours (Game Design).

schedule._dayNote: 08:30 and 13:30 are the official start and end times. Add a time to the middle item once the full schedule is known.

items.a: Students in Grades 8–12. Treasure Hunt and Shark Tank are for Grades 9–12; every other event is open to Grades 8–12.
Through the official registration form linked on this page. It opens in a new tab. This website doesn't collect any details itself.

items.q: How many teams can one school send?
items.a: Most events allow two teams per school. E-Waste Reimagined allows one to four, and Drone Race and Web Designing allow one or two.
Between two and four students, depending on the event. Game Design teams have two students and Treasure Hunt teams have three. Each event lists its exact team size.
On Saturday, 21 November 2026, at Bangalore International School, from 8:30 am to 1:30 pm.

Game Design teams bring their own laptop with their game software installed, but no game code. Drone Race teams bring their own drone, no bigger than 25 × 25 × 5 cm. Escape Room uses the host school's computers, and E-Waste Reimagined products are built on campus, with power sockets provided.
It's a Zulu greeting that means 'I see you'. Shark Tank and Web Designing ideas are built around this theme.
